records.rule: Exact decoded Classic representation exists only in protected provenance; never logs/docs.
Unicode NFC plus outer-whitespace trim; preserve case-independent display semantics, leading zeros and punctuation without decoration.
Decode declared latin1, NFC, trim outer Unicode whitespace, remove remaining Unicode whitespace, deterministic Unicode casefold/uppercase; preserve every non-whitespace code point.
Blank after canonical trim creates no alias.
Decode failure, controls/noncharacters, approved-grammar failure, display >191 or comparison >120 creates no alias.
Every member of a final-normalized source group >1 is withheld; no best owner, suffix, punctuation change or merge.

Trim, remove all POSIX whitespace and uppercase: 141 blank, 15550 unique nonblank candidates, 1259 duplicate rows/275 groups, difference zero. Refresh under the versioned Unicode/NFC runtime implementation and target collision snapshot before persistence.
Different target owner, missing/contradictory provenance, or soft-deleted/merged owner => withhold/manual review.
Collision with another live/soft-deleted/merged/archived patient number is withheld even though DB lacks cross-table uniqueness.
Same normalized alias, mapped target, protected source token and version is already-satisfied with zero write.
Must be null for direct legacy OPD alias; it is a target-patient FK and never stores Classic PAT_ID.
Null plus provenance; no Classic creator exists and Phase 2B prohibits fallback/Legacy Actor Unknown.
Persist only after patient mapping exists; entity quarantine leaves unique alias outcome pending rather than discarded.
Aliases are not soft-deleted; soft-deleted patient owner continues to reserve alias. Never auto-release or recycle.
Preflight both application canonical equality and target utf8mb4_unicode_ci uniqueness; mismatch stops.
Only controlled post-migration identity review may establish ownership; no document existence or SLA expiry releases it.
Each source patient gets exactly one alias outcome; duplicate exception count equals duplicate-withheld rows.
